Name: Rista's emotes- cats theme
Author: RistaXcorpsekitty
Description:
[code]
🐾 Custom Emojis & Menu — Aesthetic Retexture Overhaul

Transform your farm's communication into a cozy, expressive experience! Custom Emojis & Menu is a complete visual overhaul for all emotes and the selection wheel in Stardew Valley, featuring unique custom pixel art.


✨ Key Features


Cozy Aesthetic: Beautifully detailed retextures that turn standard communication icons into cute, stylized landmarks. Full Menu Overhaul: Complete pixel art replacement for both the floating overhead emotes and the radial selection menu. Vanilla Friendly: Carefully designed to blend seamlessly with the original Stardew Valley visual style and pixel grid. 1.6+ Optimized: Fully updated and built natively using the latest Content Patcher standards with fixed asset paths.

🛠 Requirements

To run this mod, you will need the latest versions of:
1. SMAPI
2. Content Patcher


💾 Installation

1. Download and install SMAPI and Content Patcher if you haven't already.
2. Download this mod and extract the ZIP file.
3. Place the extracted folder directly into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
4. Run the game using SMAPI!


📌 Known Vanilla Bug & Fix

Due to a minor hardcoded indexing quirk in the base game, some menu slots might map incorrectly upon first click after customization.
How to easily fix it directly in-game:

Press Y to open your emote wheel. Right-click on any slot showing an incorrect emote. Manually re-select your preferred icon from the full grid. The game will save this layout perfectly for your playthrough!

💬 Permissions & Credits


Author: Rista Please do not reupload this mod to other platforms without my permission. Feel free to leave a comment or report any visual bugs in the posts section.
Thank you for downloading and enjoy your cozy new emojis! 🐱

[/code]
